deployment_notes: Wrangler defaults to Workers delegation for new projects; creation failed with missing Worker entry point. Official CLI Pages force option used once to create the dedicated Pages project; later updates used normal pages deploy.
Python urllib receives Cloudflare 1010 on Pages; ordinary Chromium through the existing proxy verified live pages with TLS verification intact.
